capabilities: Format loose JSON in selections and code blocks
Preview and apply document-wide JSON formatting
Copy JSON values as JavaScript object literals
Decode stringified JSON fields by path
Repair JSON-like data to strict JSON
disambiguation: Not a strict JSON validator; loose formatting only changes layout, and strict conversion is a separate repair command.
extras: Runs fully offline with no network requests, telemetry, accounts, or clipboard reads. Default processing limit is 1 MiB (configurable 0.1-10 MiB) with maximum structural depth 128. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; mobile and minimum-version behavior are not yet tested.
problem: JSON copied from API payloads, consoles, and logs is often non-standard or embedded in surrounding text, so Obsidian cannot format it as strict JSON without manual cleanup.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the practical workflow of Simple Code Formatter, with thanks to its author.
Codeblock Customizer 1.4.7 is supported in Live Preview, source mode (when enabled in CBC), and reading mode.

summary: Offline formatter for loose or non-standard JSON in code blocks and logs, with JavaScript copying, stringified-field decoding, strict JSON repair, and log extraction.
